verdict.rationale: cfo.ai documents connecting HubSpot, Salesforce and Stripe so Ari plans from those records, forecasting revenue from business drivers, and importing actuals from QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite or Rillet. However, no evidence shows a pipeline-weighted or subscription-based revenue plan, or a plan-vs-actual variance view; tracking against actuals is only implied by the live model being rebuilt off the close. Missing for 10: explicit pipeline/subscription revenue-plan mechanics, documented plan-vs-actual variance tracking, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can build a revenue plan from CRM pipeline or subscription data and track it against actuals
